steps.label: :linux: Runtime fast checks
steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
source tools/bazel/ci-cache.sh
tools/bazel/install.sh
rustup toolchain install stable --profile minimal --component clippy,rustfmt --no-self-update
export RIVE_RUNTIME_DIR="$(pwd)/rive-runtime"
git clone --filter=blob:none https://github.com/rive-app/rive-runtime.git "$RIVE_RUNTIME_DIR"
git -C "$RIVE_RUNTIME_DIR" checkout "$RIVE_RUNTIME_REF"
make fixtures
NUXIE_CI_RUNNER_POLICY_VERSION=1 PYTHONPATH=tools:tools/bazel PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest tools/test_buildkite_pipeline.py tools/test_bazel_ci_cache.py tools/test_bazel_cache.py tools/test_bazel_runner.py tools/test_buildkite_runner_lanes.py tools/test_bazel_runtime_build.py tools/bazel/test_runtime.py tools/bazel/test_cache_policy.py tools/bazel/test_bootstrap.py -v
make fmt-check check lint-gate feature-compile-gate-portable

steps.label: :linux: Runtime port contracts
steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
source tools/bazel/ci-cache.sh
tools/bazel/install.sh
sudo apt-get update -qq
sudo apt-get install --no-install-recommends -y zlib1g-dev
export RIVE_RUNTIME_DIR="$(pwd)/rive-runtime"
git clone --filter=blob:none https://github.com/rive-app/rive-runtime.git rive-runtime
git -C rive-runtime checkout "$RIVE_RUNTIME_REF"
make fixtures
make runtime-source-correspondence-check pure-runtime-boundary-gate

steps.label: :linux: C ABI smoke
steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
source tools/bazel/ci-cache.sh
tools/bazel/install.sh
RIVE_RUNTIME_DIR="" make nux-capi-pr-gate

steps.label: :mac: Apple distribution compile
steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
source tools/bazel/ci-cache.sh
tools/bazel/install.sh
rustup toolchain install stable --profile minimal --no-self-update
rustup target add --toolchain stable \
  aarch64-apple-ios aarch64-apple-ios-sim x86_64-apple-ios \
  aarch64-apple-darwin x86_64-apple-darwin
export RIVE_RUNTIME_DIR="$(pwd)/rive-runtime"
git clone --filter=blob:none https://github.com/rive-app/rive-runtime.git "$RIVE_RUNTIME_DIR"
git -C "$RIVE_RUNTIME_DIR" checkout "$RIVE_RUNTIME_REF"
make fixtures
make feature-compile-gate-apple

steps.label: :linux: Nightly full runtime confidence
steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
source tools/bazel/ci-cache.sh
tools/bazel/install.sh
sudo apt-get update -qq
sudo apt-get install --no-install-recommends -y zlib1g-dev
export RIVE_RUNTIME_DIR="$(pwd)/rive-runtime"
git clone --filter=blob:none https://github.com/rive-app/rive-runtime.git rive-runtime
git -C rive-runtime checkout "$RIVE_RUNTIME_REF"
rustup toolchain install stable --profile minimal --component clippy,rustfmt --no-self-update
make fixtures
make fmt-check check
make runtime-source-correspondence-check pure-runtime-boundary-gate
make lint-gate feature-compile-gate-portable
(
  cd "$RIVE_RUNTIME_DIR"
  RIVE_PREMAKE_ARGS="--file=premake5_v2.lua --with_rive_text --with_rive_layout" \
    build/build_rive.sh nobuild
)
export PATH="$RIVE_RUNTIME_DIR/build/dependencies/premake-core/bin/${RIVE_PREMAKE_TAG}_release:$PATH"
make cpp-probe cpp-probe-scripted
tools/bazel/runtime.py test --workspace --exclude nuxie-renderer

steps.label: :mac: Nightly renderer and Apple confidence
steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
source tools/bazel/ci-cache.sh
tools/bazel/install.sh
export RIVE_RUNTIME_DIR="$(pwd)/rive-runtime"
git clone --filter=blob:none https://github.com/rive-app/rive-runtime.git rive-runtime
git -C rive-runtime checkout "$RIVE_RUNTIME_REF"
rustup toolchain install stable --profile minimal --component llvm-tools --no-self-update
rustup target add --toolchain stable wasm32-unknown-unknown
make fixtures
make microbench-gate
make capi-smoke
make feature-compile-gate-apple
tools/bazel/runtime.py test -p nuxie-renderer
make crate-seams-browser-check
